name: reminders
description: Surfaces set-reminders markdown files as a status bar count, a quick pick, and a panel view.

reminders.directory.markdownDescription: Directory holding the reminder files, **relative to the workspace root**. Absolute paths are not supported in v1.

reminders.openStatus.markdownDescription: The `**Status:**` value that counts as outstanding. The vocabulary belongs to the skill, not to this extension.

reminders.warnOnAudience.markdownDescription: Audiences that turn the status bar amber. A reminder addressed to the learner happens during a session, in their time, and competes with the teaching.

reminders.statusBarPriority.markdownDescription: Status bar priority. Higher is further left. VS Code registers Problems at 50, so 49 sits just right of it — observed, not contracted, which is why this is a setting.

reminders.closedLabel.markdownDescription: The bold label written beneath `**Status:**` when a reminder is closed. Must match whatever `SKILL.md` specifies.
